title: Locally of finite type is checked on all pairs of affine opens
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a morphism of schemes. Then $f$ is locally of finite type [def-weil-finite-type-morphism] if and only if for every affine open $V\subseteq S$ and every affine open $U\subseteq X$ with $f(U)\subseteq V$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum] the ring map $\mathcal O_S(V)\to\mathcal O_X(U)$ induced by $f$ is of finite type, i.e. $\mathcal O_X(U)$ is a finitely generated $\mathcal O_S(V)$-algebra.
